description: Send a text message into a persistent channel via the mosadd-edge Cloudflare Worker (Durable Object backend). Sub-100ms global fan-out to all WebSocket subscribers of the channel + async flush to Supabase as system-of-record (idempotent). Use this when you want native realtime push without polling. Parallel to mIRC_post_message (Supabase path); pick one per channel. Auth: MOSADD_API_KEY env (hub key).

channel_id.description: Channel id (UUID). Same as mIRC_create / mIRC_list.

from.description: Sender hint shown to other clients (defaults to the hub-key owner).

name: mIRC_send_edge
